note: Out-of-band price catalog for dsh-plugin-cost-meter. Every rate is USD per 1,000,000 tokens. `cacheMiss`/`cacheHit`/`output` are the PEAK (full) rates; the `*OffPeak` fields are the discounted rates. The plugin reads this file from its own package and, when `catalogUrl` is set (the default derives from package.json repository), re-reads the same shape from the network on an interval — pushing a new version of this file updates every installed copy without publishing a plugin release. Rates captured 2026-09 from the vendor-published table; DeepSeek announced Flash price cuts in 2026-09, so verify against https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing before relying on them.

peakSchedule.note: Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Monday through Friday (09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing); every other hour, plus the whole weekend, is off-peak at half price.

deepseek-v4-flash.label: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (legacy alias)
deepseek-v4-flash.note: The V4 Flash name is still accepted and served by V4.1 Flash at the Flash price.

deepseek-chat.label: DeepSeek Chat (legacy)
deepseek-chat.note: Legacy flat-price model; the off-peak fields repeat the peak rate so it is never discounted.

deepseek-reasoner.label: DeepSeek Reasoner (legacy)
deepseek-reasoner.note: Legacy flat-price model; the off-peak fields repeat the peak rate so it is never discounted.
